info.name: Zendesk Account Account Settings Custom Ticket Statuses API
Zendesk Put  Api V2 Custom_status Default

items.docs:
Updates the default values for many custom ticket statuses at once.

#### Allowed For

* Admins

params.name: status_categories
params.description: Filter the list of custom ticket statuses by a comma-separated list of status categories

params.name: active
params.description: If true, show only active custom ticket statuses. If false, show only inactive custom ticket statuses. If the filter is not used, show all custom ticket statuses

params.name: default
params.description: If true, show only default custom ticket statuses. If false, show only non-default custom ticket statuses. If the filter is not used, show all custom ticket statuses

items.docs:
Lists all undeleted custom ticket statuses for the account. No pagination is provided.

#### Allowed For

* End Users

Takes a `custom_status` object that specifies the custom ticket status properties to create.
